author: iFixit
description:
Apple brought touch to the MacBook Pro—and brought the glowing Apple back. We opened it up to see what changed, and what happens when it needs a repair.

In this teardown of the 14-inch MacBook Pro with ProLED XDR, we examine its tandem OLED display under a microscope, test touch and Touch ID after a logic board swap, and go inside the lid to uncover the logo’s dedicated lighting assembly.

We also investigate battery removal, modular ports that still require logic board removal, fan access, soldered storage and RAM, and the display’s difficult disassembly.

The result: 5/10 for repairability. There’s progress here—but some familiar repair compromises remain.

title: Inside Apple’s Most Interesting MacBook Display
